note: Cross-domain planning evals written when a project-specific production workflow was generalized. These prompts are review fixtures, not claims of completed recordings or measured results.

evals.name: node-cli-capture-plan
evals.prompt: Take /workspace/json-pretty-cli and make a short VS Code video showing npm test, then formatting fixtures/input.json with node bin/pretty.js. Show the output file and give me the recording plan before touching the UI.
evals.fixture_spec: A small Node.js CLI repository with package.json, bin/pretty.js, test/pretty.test.js and fixtures/input.json. It has no video conventions or workstation-specific paths.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the project and applicable Node documentation, proposes the exact initial frame, command sequence, visible proof, narration beats, disposable-copy location and cleanup, then waits for approval without recording.
assertions: Does not start UI automation or recording before approval
Uses the exact project path and verified commands instead of framework assumptions
Shows both test success and the formatted output as separate proof beats
Keeps workstation geometry and disposable-copy root configurable
Names the production artifacts and cleanup behavior

evals.name: web-app-runtime-proof
evals.prompt: Plan a tutorial from /workspace/inventory-web that starts its dev server, changes the stock filter in VS Code, and proves the result in the browser. I want English narration and selectable captions.
evals.fixture_spec: A Vite web application with a documented npm run dev command, a StockFilter component and local fixture data. The browser can be opened without authentication or network access.
evals.expected_output: Loads appropriate web/UI expertise, proposes a deterministic server-readiness check and browser proof, keeps setup outside capture, and separates narration source from SRT spelling.
assertions: Routes technical claims through applicable domain skills or primary project documentation
Waits for observable server readiness instead of a long arbitrary sleep
Defines the browser state that proves the filter works
Keeps English voice text and selectable captions as separate artifacts
Does not publish or create paid voice audio without authorization

evals.name: retake-audio-alignment
evals.prompt: The take is good, but paragraph three says the build completed before the terminal reaches Finished. Fix the same recorder, keep my original voice file, and make take 2.
evals.fixture_spec: An approved technical-video package with recording plan, permanent recorder, take-01 MOV, event log, paragraph-based narration, original external voice MP3 and cue sheet.
evals.expected_output: Edits the permanent recipe rather than creating a throwaway script, preserves the supplied audio, records take 2 after a clapperboard warning, asks for the live review, and performs block-level alignment only after acceptance.
assertions: Modifies the permanent recorder or recipe instead of creating a take-specific automation script
Never overwrites take 1 or the supplied audio
Announces the real capture with a clapperboard in a separate update
Uses actual event timing for the Finished beat
Keeps a clean post-roll and does not use one unrelated long pause to absorb drift
